messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis mean 98.6. They ask: "計算...的標準差" maybe they want the standard error? Or they want the p-value? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might refer to the standard error of the mean under null? Actually "零假設檢定的標準差" could be "standard deviation for the null hypothesis test"? Might be the standard error of the difference between sample mean and population mean? But we can compute the standard error of the sample mean: SE = sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Let's compute: sqrt(40)=6.3249; 1.4/6.3249=0.2213. So SE ~0.221. Then t-statistic: (sample_mean - population_mean)/SE = (98.2-98.6)/0.2213 = (-0.4)/0.2213 = -1.807. Then degrees of freedom df = n-1 = 39. Two-tailed p-value: 2 * P(T <= -1.807) with df=39. We can approximate using t distribution. For df=39, t=1.807 gives p ~0.08? Let's approximate: For df=30, t=1.697 gives p=0.10; t=2.042 gives p=0.05. So t=1.807 likely p ~0.08. So p-value ~0.08. But the question: "計算...的標準差" maybe they want the standard error? They might want the standard deviation of the sampling distribution of the mean: sigma/sqrt(n). That is 1.4/sqrt(40)=0.221. So answer: 0.221. But they might want the standard deviation of the null hypothesis test? Actually "零假設檢定的標準差" might refer to the standard error used in the t-test. So answer: 0.221. Provide explanation. Use the function? The tool calculates p-value. But they didn't ask for p-value. They asked for standard deviation. So no function call needed. Just compute manually. Provide result.
